name: Pasqal
description: Pasqal builds neutral-atom quantum processors for solving real-world optimization and simulation problems. Founded by pioneers of cold atom physics including Alain Aspect (Nobel laureate), Pasqal delivers quantum computing solutions to enterprise clients in energy, automotive, and finance.

products.name: Neutral-Atom QPU
products.description: Programmable neutral-atom quantum processors with up to 1,000 qubits for optimization and simulation

products.name: Pasqal Cloud
products.description: Cloud access platform for running quantum workloads on Pasqal neutral-atom hardware

highlights: Co-founded by Nobel laureate Alain Aspect, a pioneer of cold atom physics
EUR 100M+ raised with plans for a USD 2B SPAC listing
200+ employees delivering enterprise quantum solutions in energy, automotive, and finance

sources.title: Quantum scale-up Pasqal plans $2B SPAC listing
Pasqal Showcases Quantum Progress at 2026 Event - The Quantum Insider

news.title: Pasqal closes €340M financing in anticipation of public listing
news.excerpt: €170M private round plus €170M convertible financing from Parkway, Quanta Computer, LG Electronics and CMA CGM ahead of dual Nasdaq and Euronext listing.

news.title: Pasqal announces intention to go public in $2B SPAC deal
news.excerpt: Merger with Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II values Pasqal at about $2 billion and could bring $600M+ in total proceeds.

news.title: Pasqal Thoughts 2026 event marks quantum computing's shift from research to real-world deployment
news.excerpt: More than 150 participants from 10+ countries gathered in Paris to discuss industry use cases in finance, energy, and telecom, and Pasqal's path toward 1,000-qubit systems and HPC integration.

news.title: PINQ² becomes exclusive Canadian distributor of Pasqal neutral-atom quantum computers
news.excerpt: Partnership with PINQ² and Distriq gives Canadian enterprises and researchers access to Pasqal's neutral-atom platform for applications in energy, finance, aerospace, and materials science.
